name: Paywall
summary: Wrap a pro-gated affordance; the shared upsell renders itself — the crown upgrade mark, title, one-sentence body, the fixed unlock line, and Upgrade + See all plans CTAs are baked in.
lead: EVERY pro-gated affordance routes through one element so both products feel like one. You give <aha-paywall> the feature, the copy and the plan; it renders the compliant popover — the purple crown upgrade mark (never a generic crown glyph), the title, the one-sentence benefit, the fixed "Unlock with the <Plan> plan." line, and two shared <aha-button> CTAs: Upgrade (positive/green) + See all plans (secondary). Analytics comes back as events. A hand-rolled upgrade modal/tooltip is the drift this replaces.

spec.label: Upgrade mark
spec.value: 16×16 purple circle (--aha-color-primary) + white crown — a focusable control with Default/Hover/Active states; the custom mark, not a Phosphor crown

spec.label: Popover
spec.value: dark indigo surface #242442 (--aha-bg-dark-raised), 300px wide, 16px padding, radius 12; animates opacity + lift on open via the motion tokens

spec.label: Anatomy
spec.value: header (crown + title) · body (one sentence + "Unlock with the <Plan> plan.") · footer (Upgrade + See all plans)

spec.label: Buttons
spec.value: TWO shared <aha-button>s — Upgrade (variant=positive, green --aha-button-positive-bg) + See all plans (variant=secondary, re-themed for the dark surface); never hand-rolled

spec.label: Analytics
spec.value: paywall-shown on open · paywall-upgrade before Upgrade nav · paywall-plans before See-all-plans nav — all { feature, plan }

spec.label: Behaviour
spec.value: Upgrade opens ahaslides.com/pricing (new tab, noopener); See all plans opens plans-url; preventDefault either event to run your own flow. Esc / click-away close

props.name: feature-key
props.desc: Stable token (e.g. custom_survey_url) — drives analytics + DOM hooks. Required.

props.name: feature-label
props.desc: Short noun-phrase title next to the crown (used as the popover title unless title is set)

props.name: title
props.desc: Popover title override; falls back to feature-label. May wrap to two lines

props.name: body
props.desc: Exactly one sentence describing the benefit of unlocking; ends with a period

props.name: description
props.desc: Popover description override; falls back to body

props.name: required-plan
props.desc: Drives the unlock line and the analytics plan prop

props.name: placement
props.desc: Popover side relative to the anchor

props.name: trigger
props.desc: How the popover opens; click-away + Escape close a click popover

props.name: cta-label
props.desc: The positive CTA verb; override only with a clear reason

props.name: plans-label
props.desc: The secondary CTA label — routes to the full pricing page

props.name: plans-url
props.desc: Where See all plans navigates (new tab, noopener)

props.name: slot (default)
props.desc: The gated affordance = the anchor; omit it to use the crown upgrade mark as the anchor

props.name: paywall-shown / paywall-upgrade / paywall-plans
props.desc: Analytics contract; paywall-upgrade + paywall-plans are cancelable (preventDefault to run your own flow)

whenToUse.when: any feature locked behind a paid plan — editor affordance, share option, results feature, dashboard action
the feature has no natural clickable anchor (e.g. a field label) — omit the slot and the crown is the anchor
the default gate; use essential only for essential-tier features
a hand-rolled upgrade modal/tooltip drifts from the presenter app — always this element

opinion.note: Feature label is a short noun phrase; body is exactly one sentence about the benefit (not "This is a Pro feature"); the unlock line is fixed — do not reword. Popover/placement mechanics defer to aha-design-overlays; a single plan-gated setting row lives in the Settings surface.

codeNote: One zero-dep custom element renders the shared upsell; the paywall skill's rules (crown-not-Phosphor upgrade mark, one-sentence body, fixed unlock line, Upgrade + See all plans CTAs — both the shared <aha-button>, the analytics events, dark-indigo 300/16/12 surface) are baked into its shadow DOM — a consumer can't hand-roll a drifting prompt. The popover animates opacity+lift on a persistent node via the motion tokens; the anchor carries aria-expanded and Escape closes it. The judge/eval + copy voice stay in the aha-design skill.

selfCheck.label: Upgrade (positive) + See all plans (secondary) — both shared <aha-button> (PAYWALL-04)
requiredPlan essential|pro drives unlock line + analytics (PAYWALL-07)

conformance.$about: Measured against the RENDERED shadow-DOM UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The [data-probe] paywall is shown OPEN so the popover — dark surface, radius, crown mark, and the two shared <aha-button> CTAs — is measurable. The Upgrade button's green is read from inside aha-button's own shadow root (the primitive it reuses).
conformance.measure: (function(){var s=document.querySelector('aha-paywall[data-probe]').shadowRoot; var g=function(sel,p){var el=s.querySelector(sel); return el?getComputedStyle(el)[p]:null;}; var btnBg=function(sel){var b=s.querySelector(sel); var inner=b&&b.shadowRoot&&b.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); return inner?getComputedStyle(inner).backgroundColor:null;}; return { popoverBg:g('.pop','backgroundColor'), popoverRadius:g('.pop','borderTopLeftRadius'), popoverWidth:g('.pop','width'), upgradeBg:btnBg('.upgrade'), markBg:g('.phead .mark','backgroundColor'), crownPresent:!!s.querySelector('.phead .mark aha-icon[name="system-crown-badge-fill"]'), plansPresent:!!(s.querySelector('.plans')&&s.querySelector('.plans').textContent.trim()==='See all plans'), planLabel:(s.querySelector('.punlock b')||{}).textContent };})()
